## History

Isolde Duckett spent the morning of her wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill), where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) assisted her in getting dressed and preparing for the occasion. She subsequently completed her wedding ceremony and took part in the following celebration.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017)_

## Quotes

> "My new home won't be distant. Our affection for one another will remain just as strong. That friendship ‘oath’ we pledged so many years ago has never been broken by us, has it?"
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003)

> "Hold on until it is your turn, Miss Nell. Oh, Nell, my ear catches father walking up the stairs. Hand me my bouquet. Is my veil positioned correctly? Do I look extremely pale?"
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P9](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0009)

> "Oh, Nell—I am terribly anxious—I am unable to carry on—Nell, I am certain that I shall lose consciousness."
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P7](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0007)

> "The unkind aspect of your upcoming wedding is my inability to serve as your bridesmaid"
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P5](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0005)

> "However, Isolde Duckett is going to. Look, mother is shouting for us. Let's go."
>
> — Isolde Duckett — [v3 ch.Wedding P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-duckett--nell-harcourt.md)

Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a close friendship, with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acting as a supportive presence on Isolde's wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) assists Isolde with dressing and preparing for the ceremony, where the two exchange warm affection before the event.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), +4 more_
